first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The dark blue single-seat open-wheel race car from whose cockpit the current view is shown; the bodywork on both sides, black front wheels, and a dark protective frame with a central pillar are visible.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved road surface visible ahead of and on both sides of Vehicle A, extending along a gentle right-hand bend toward the gantry ahead.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: The large expanse of light blue sky within the opening of the protective frame and above the distant scenery.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The driver holding the steering wheel inside Vehicle A; only both hands wearing dark blue gloves and parts of the forearms are visible.

entities.name: multi-button steering wheel
entities.identification: The black irregularly shaped steering wheel held by Person A, with colored buttons, circular knobs, and a silver-gray concave curved upper edge.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The distant low-slung race car on the racetrack ahead of Vehicle A, appearing in the final frame as a small dark silhouette slightly right of center with a small amount of bright coloring.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The narrow alternating red-and-white paved strip along the right edge of the racetrack.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The low green grass strip and grassy areas outside the road.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The green trees distributed in clusters on both sides of the road and in the distance.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: The continuous low wall around the outside of the road, mainly consisting of light-colored wall sections on the right, with some wall sections on the left bearing green advertising panels.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: The fence around the outside of the road, consisting of repeated vertical posts, horizontal wires, and fine mesh.

entities.name: tiered grandstand
entities.identification: The tiered seating structures on the right and in the distance ahead, with a broad light-colored canopy over part of the structure on the right.

entities.name: cross-track gantry
entities.identification: The green rectangular gantry above the racetrack ahead, with pale yellow logos repeated across its face.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: The long green advertising panels, rectangular signs, and distance boards legible in some frames beside the road.

entities.name: spectators beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The background groups of spectators in the grandstand behind the mesh fence on the right and on the nearby grassy slope.

entities.name: cockpit instrument display
entities.identification: The fixed black rectangular digital display above and behind the steering wheel, showing light-colored readings and colored bars below.
